subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: How should maintainers split #86567, and which dashboard auth persistence, Codex/OpenAI OAuth propagation, runtime upgrade, and context-liveness contracts should OpenClaw support?
rationale: The remaining work changes credential persistence and propagation, upgrade behavior, installer/runtime compatibility, and terminal session semantics; those are product and security boundary choices rather than a safe one-shot repair.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Keep this issue as the coordinating umbrella and make each active subproblem own its security/product contract and proof path.

options.title: Close After Canonical Links
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers designate narrower open issues as the sole canonical tracking items for every remaining acceptance criterion.

options.title: Run A Broad Reliability Program
options.body: Treat the issue as one maintainer-led project spanning auth, installer, runtime, and context-management rather than ClawSweeper automation.

recommendation.title: Split Into Narrow Canonicals
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the coordinating umbrella and make each active subproblem own its security/product contract and proof path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears across provider identity, Codex OAuth bridge ownership, doctor docs, and runtime terminal-state history, making it the best routing owner for the split decision.
